name: Charles Degold Gomez
bio: Charles Degold Gomez is the founder and executive director of BethGold Foundation. Living with visual impairment since childhood, he faced prejudice and job rejection rooted in societal bias — and turned to education, advocacy, and community outreach as his response, using media campaigns and grassroots engagement to challenge stereotypes about disability. He now leads BethGold Foundation's advocacy work in The Gambia, hosts the weekly Disability Radio Talk Show on Radio Veritas 102.9FM, and serves as EnAble India's regional coordinating partner for Discovery Award Africa.

name: Samuel Okafor
bio: Samuel oversees all field operations and project delivery, bringing over 10 years of experience in community development and humanitarian response across West Africa.

name: Amina Diallo
bio: Amina leads strategic partnerships and donor relations, connecting the foundation with NGOs, institutions, and corporate partners who share our commitment to positive change.

name: James Mensah
bio: James coordinates all health outreach initiatives, working directly with communities to deliver free medical care, screenings, and health education programs.
